regression.coverage: Both either and bottom requests on the real carrier USB-JTAG input must reject specifically for the DP90_USB reference-plane constraint. Original input remains untouched. Existing carrier/devkit production and top-preferred structural, physical and repeatability checks execute unchanged.
regression.observation: Process was confirmed live and CPU-active at 132 seconds. It completed normally before a requested one-second stack sample could attach; it was not restarted.

architecture_finding.semantics: The same_side structure's ics list applies each owner to its own contract members; it does not force all listed ICs onto one common face. Proximity links connect Y1's load caps transitively to U1. Switch and testpoints remain governed by face_top.
architecture_finding.implementation_boundary: pcb_placement_zones.cpp sets every template contract member top before build_pcb_stage_zone. pcb_stage_zone.cpp exports every solved contract part into result.top. Whole-zone bottom eligibility rejects any controlled net on that sheet before constructing alternatives.
architecture_finding.next_direction: Implement bounded group-local alternatives preserving contract-connected components, controlled-net owners and face-top controls. Reuse exact footprint mirroring, named-pad geometry and complete contract/physical checks. A structurally independent component is not proof of hardware-safe bottom eligibility; assembly, height, return-path and thermal evidence still matter.
architecture_finding.not_authorized_by_this_evidence: Do not disable the DP90_USB gate, change the stackup implicitly, move USB controlled-net parts onto unreferenced B.Cu, split same-side proximity groups, or treat the contract partition as fabrication approval.

limitations: No smaller board or new accepted layout in this batch.
No production side policy changed, no hardware limit invented and no electrical gate waived.
No full build/render or timing comparison repeated for failed screens.
Qualified carrier remains 168x159 and devkit 98x98; unresolved hardware requirements and the broader goal remain open.
